limitations: Source parents have no human quality labels and are not verified clean references.
Existing variants were generated before fixed-view preparation; source-parent and variant paths differ.
dHash is a conservative duplicate heuristic, not proof that all visual or semantic overlap is absent.
No training row has OTH as its dominant human flaw; the six observed strata are used.

selection_policy.method: SHA-256 of JSON [seed, stage, category, image_id]; smallest first
selection_policy.near_duplicate_exclusion: Reject dHash Hamming distance <= 2 against prior-family rows and earlier stages
selection_policy.prior_exclusion: All source train rows in any family used by the prior 12 views
selection_policy.source_parent: Existing Megalith train row; no ICC profile or alpha/transparency metadata
selection_policy.standalone_megalith: 12 rows per stage; exclude all parents of existing distortion families
selection_policy.vizwiz_stratum: Largest human named-flaw vote count; alphabetical code breaks ties; no score inference
selection_policy.within_stage: Family siblings are allowed; distinct selections cannot share any exact exclusion key
